question.html:
A metal rod is pulled along two horizontal conducting rails X and Y so that it rolls to the right at a constant speed. The two rails are connected by a straight conducting wire of Length L = 0.60 m. The system is in a region of uniform magnetic field of magnitude B = 1.2 T directed into the page.

a As a result of the motion, the metal rod experiences a magnetic force of 0.084 N.

a.i Show that the current in the metal rod is about 0.1 A. [1]

a.ii State the direction of the magnetic force on an electron in the metal rod. [1]

a.iii The magnitude of the magnetic field on the right-hand side of the rod is different from that on the left-hand side. Explain why. [3]

a.iv Outline how Lenz’s law applies to this system. [2]

b Determine, using your answer from (a)(i), the force per unit length between rails X and Y. State the fundamental SI units for your answer. [3]
